packages.label: 01 / LEARN IT
packages.title: Learn to build your own website with AI.
packages.intro: No experience needed. We’ll guide you step by step over Zoom, using your own idea to build a website together.
packages.name: Your Complete Website Course
packages.unit: Four private Zoom lessons · 60 minutes each
items: Lesson 1: Use AI and create your first webpage.
Lesson 2: Add your pictures, words and business information.
Lesson 3: Make it beautiful and mobile-friendly.
Lesson 4: Put your website online and learn how to update it.
packages.note: One complete course, with personal guidance from your first webpage to publishing a simple website.
packages.subject: Book my website course

packages.label: 02 / BUILD IT
packages.title: Let us build and maintain your website.
packages.intro: You run your business. We’ll take care of your website. Tell us what you need, and we’ll create something you can be proud of.
packages.name: Complete Business Website
items: A professional website designed for your business.
Looks good on phones, tablets and computers.
Basic setup to help Google and AI search tools understand your website.
Website publishing and two rounds of changes.
packages.note: We agree the pages and features before starting. Domain, hosting and any paid services are quoted separately.

update.text: For a small update to existing pages, such as changing pictures, prices or text. Larger changes quoted first. No monthly maintenance subscription.

packages.subject: Build my website

packages.label: 03 / GROW IT
packages.title: Now let’s find you customers.
packages.intro: Your website is ready. How do you reach customers? We find people and businesses who might need your services, then email them individually with a personal message.
packages.name: Your 100-Prospect Outreach Campaign
items: Write and send 100 individual introduction emails.
Follow up once with each person, where appropriate.
Monitor replies and help develop conversations.
Identify genuine interest and possible business opportunities.
Report who we contacted, their replies and the opportunities identified.
packages.note: We’ve spent months refining this approach for our own projects. Campaign details and messaging are agreed before we begin. Replies, interested leads and sales vary by business and market.
packages.subject: Discuss my 100-prospect campaign
